item.title: Netanyahu’s “Proof of Life” Video Is Real. Here’s Why Some Claim Otherwise.
item.description: Iranian state media and other pro-Iran accounts claim that a video of the Israeli prime minister at a cafe is AI-generated — part of a baseless narrative that he was killed in an Iranian strike.

item.title: Iran Overstates Its Global Oil Disruption
item.description: Aided by a Google AI editing tool, Iranian state media claims that Australia’s fuel reserve is practically depleted, portraying the U.S. ally as sputtering due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Erika Kirk in the Epstein Files? Nope.
item.description: Conspiracy theorists falsely claim that Charlie Kirk’s widow recruited young girls for Jeffrey Epstein — citing an Epstein file phone recording of a different woman.
